decisions.reason: As a multi-model safety shoe line in the firm's core category that has already remained in the range through its first year, it is likely to be kept unless sales have materially underperformed expectations.

The comfort insole still fits the firm's footwear system offering, but accessories are easier to streamline and the prior withdrawal of another insole suggests some continuing portfolio-rationalization risk.
The ergonomic safety shoe series appears strategically important and differentiated within the main footwear business, so management would normally continue to support it.
Firefighter and rescue boots are well aligned with the firm's protective-footwear capabilities, though their narrower niche means they carry somewhat more pruning risk than broad industrial lines.
Because the moulded insole was presented as a flagship direction and remains closely tied to the firm's innovation story, withdrawal within the coming year is still very unlikely.
